items.title: 23.4.1 Preparation of Carboxylic Acids (carboxylic acids banana) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.4.1 with Quick Check 23.3 (answers need review), printed pages 105-106 (PDF 108-109).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids neeche diye gaye tareeqon se banaye ja sakte hain.
a) Primary alcohols aur aldehydes ki oxidation

Carboxylic acids primary alcohols aur aldehydes ki oxidation se bante hain. Starting material (shuru wali cheez) ko excess (zyada) acidified KMnO₄ ya acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath reflux kiya jata hai (garam kar ke bhaap ko wapas flask mein girne diya jata hai).

blocks.alt: Do equations, arrow ke oopar K2Cr2O7/dil. H2SO4 aur neeche Heat. Ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH, + 2[O] se ethanoic acid, CH3-C(=O)-OH, + H2O. Ethanal, CH3-C(=O)-H, + [O] se ethanoic acid.
blocks.caption: a) Ethanol aur ethanal ki oxidation se ethanoic acid (kitab ke page 108 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar wali equation mein ethanol (primary alcohol) 2[O] le kar ethanoic acid aur paani banata hai. Neeche wali mein ethanal (aldehyde) sirf aik [O] le kar ethanoic acid ban jata hai; is mein paani nahi banta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ethanal wali equation mein daen taraf '+ H₂O' bhi likha hai, jis se equation balanced nahi rehti (baen taraf 4 H, daen taraf 6 H). Sahi: CH₃CHO + [O] → CH₃COOH; diagram isi tarah bana hai.

Alkane nitriles acidic medium mein seedhe carboxylic acids mein hydrolyse ho jate hain. Alkaline hydrolysis mein pehle carboxylic acids ke salts bante hain, jo acid dalne (acidification) par carboxylic acids dete hain.

blocks.alt: Teen equations. CH3-CN + 2H2O + HCl -> CH3-C(=O)-OH + NH4Cl. CH3-CN + H2O + NaOH -> CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + NH3 (gas). CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + HCl -> CH3-C(=O)-OH + NaCl.
blocks.caption: b) Acid aur alkali mein ethanenitrile ki hydrolysis, aur salt ki acidification (acid dalna) (kitab ke page 109 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Acid (HCl) ke saath CH₃–CN se seedha CH₃COOH aur NH₄Cl bante hain. NaOH ke saath pehle salt CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ aur NH₃ gas banti hai; phir HCl dalne se salt CH₃COOH aur NaCl de deta hai.
Jab ester ko dilute acid ya dilute alkali ke saath reflux kiya jaye to ester hydrolyse ho kar carboxylic acid ya carboxylate ion deta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen equations. Ethyl ethanoate, CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3, + H2O(l), equilibrium arrows par H3O+, se CH3-C(=O)-OH + CH3-CH2-OH. Ethyl ethanoate + NaOH(aq) se CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + CH3-CH2-OH; 'Bond breaks' wala arrow C=O carbon aur O ke beech wale bond ki taraf. CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NaCl.
blocks.caption: c) Acid aur alkali mein ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis, aur salt ki acidification (acid dalna) (kitab ke page 109 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Acid ke saath ester ki hydrolysis reversible (ulat sakne wali) hai, is liye equilibrium ke arrows hain. Alkali (NaOH) ke saath bana acid foran salt (CH₃COO⁻Na⁺) ban jata hai aur wapas ester nahi banta, is liye yeh reaction mukammal hota hai. 'Bond breaks' batata hai ke ester ka C(=O)–O bond toot'ta hai. Aakhir mein HCl dal kar salt se acid wapas milta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne NaOH wali hydrolysis mein bhi equilibrium ke arrows chhape hain. NaOH ke saath reaction mukammal hota hai, is liye one-way arrow (→) sahi hai; diagram mein yahi dikhaya gaya hai.
Methylbenzene acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ se aasani se oxidise ho kar benzoic acid ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Methylbenzene (CH3 wala benzene ring) + 3[O], arrow ke oopar KMnO4 aur neeche dil. H2SO4; Heat, se benzene carboxylic acid (COOH wala benzene ring) + H2O.
blocks.caption: d) Methylbenzene ki oxidation se benzenecarboxylic acid (benzoic acid) (kitab ke page 109 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene ring par laga CH₃ group oxidise ho kar COOH ban jata hai, ring waise hi rehti hai: C₆H₅CH₃ + 3[O] → C₆H₅COOH + H₂O.

blocks.prompt: a) Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se propanol (propan-1-ol) ki oxidation ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + 2[O] → CH₃CH₂COOH + H₂O (propanoic acid; pehle propanal banta hai, phir woh acid ban jata hai).

blocks.prompt: b) Products aur equations batayein: (i) CH₃CH₂CN ki hydrolysis, (ii) ethylbenzene ki oxidation, (iii) ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis.
blocks.explanation:
(i) CH₃CH₂CN + 2H₂O + HCl → CH₃CH₂COOH + NH₄Cl (propanoic acid).
(ii) C₆H₅CH₂CH₃ + 6[O] → C₆H₅COOH + CO₂ + 2H₂O (benzoic acid; KMnO₄, heat).
(iii) CH₃COOCH₂CH₃ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COOH + CH₃CH₂OH (ethanoic acid aur ethanol).

items: Primary alcohol ya aldehyde + [O] (excess acidified KMnO₄/K₂Cr₂O₇, reflux) → carboxylic acid.
Nitrile ya ester ki hydrolysis: acid mein seedha acid; alkali mein pehle salt, phir HCl se acid.
